changelog: Golden Mic — app renamed to Golden Mic. Golden EQ is now the default (60Hz 0, 230Hz +5, 910Hz +5, 3600Hz +6, 14000Hz +2), Auto EQ sets the Golden EQ when you raise the gain, golden mic logo, Mic button now glows when ON, new onboarding with one Next & Agree button and a short disclaimer paragraph above it, and two Rescue opt-in tick boxes (one in onboarding next to Next & Agree, one in the Rescue Booster area — both unchecked by default, tick to turn Rescue on). Admin panel is the Vercel panel.
